title: IdentityLink
description: Reveal-scoped link between two entities (for example two personas confirmed as one person). Before its boundary the projection must render them as separate entities.

reveal_char_end.description: Right-endpoint character offset within the first_reveal window at or after which this identity link becomes visible.

epistemic_status.description: Epistemic certainty of the identity link. Only OBSERVED, unframed links collapse DSU clusters; omitted defaults to OBSERVED for v1 compatibility.

frame_id.description: Optional hypothesis or narrative frame identifier scoping this link; framed links remain uncollapsed across canonical projection views.
